audit.definition: Sixty-eight directly quantitative source rows plus three inferred upper limits on local bulk fallout. Lake bounds condition on a concentration-depth response at least as high as the published B-Tm reference at Suigetsu. The peat bound conditions on a three-slice mass budget and a bulk-density floor. Each interpreted site enters once.

prior.name: baseline
prior.kernel_weights: Symmetric Dirichlet(total concentration kernel_concentration) over Gaussian, exponential, power components, shared across fans
prior.noise: HalfNormal(noise_scale); broad-error fraction Beta(1,9), fourfold residual SD
prior.interpretation: Proper modelling assumptions, not extra observations or geological facts. Identical prior specification for every eruption.
prior.angular_prior: Independent Normal(0,angular_sd) coefficients; no fitted displacement

diagnostics.interpretation: Rank-normalized split R-hat and bulk/tail ESS across independent chains. Fan labels are exchangeable; field and volume diagnostics are used instead. Passing diagnostics does not prove global mode exploration or model correctness.
diagnostics.assessment: R-hat <1.01, bulk/tail ESS >=400, zero divergences, every chain's energy BFMI >=0.3. Maximum-depth saturation is a separate efficiency warning. Source-fan normalization must also pass angular refinement at relative tolerance 1e-6.

validation.interpretation: Full matched training-fold posterior, fixed bearing prior and training-only support. Scores include exact readings and limit events.

source_checks.interpretation: Retention is at most one and equals one at the vent. A source-focused parent therefore keeps its maximum at the source. Local bound anchors can interrupt radial monotonicity.

reproducibility.normalization: Finite-Earth component normalization followed by positive quadrature of retained mass under each normalized parent mixture.

bearing.posterior_interpretation: Parent amplitude and kernel parameters follow the original posterior. The principal mass is its integrated retained fraction times parent volume. A single latent orientation applies to a complete deposit.
bearing.numerical_interpretation: NUTS diagnostics and attempt histories describe parent draws. Each fit separately records spatial integration and split-draw checks on derived volume.
